0.title: 🚦 DEPLOYMENT GATE
0.query:
timeseries availability = avg(dt.synthetic.http.availability), from: now()-7d, filter:{ dt.entity.http_check == "HTTP_CHECK-63169A43EEB83483" }
| fieldsAdd avg_availability = arrayAvg(availability)
| fieldsAdd slo_target = toDouble($slo_target)
| fieldsAdd total_minutes = toDouble($eval_days) * 24.0 * 60.0
| fieldsAdd allowed_downtime = (100.0 - slo_target) / 100.0 * total_minutes
| fieldsAdd actual_downtime = (100.0 - avg_availability) / 100.0 * total_minutes
| fieldsAdd budget_consumed_pct = round(actual_downtime / allowed_downtime * 100.0, decimals:1)
| fieldsAdd deployment_gate = if(budget_consumed_pct <= 50, then:1, else:if(budget_consumed_pct <= 100, then:2, else:3))
| fields deployment_gate

1.content:
# 🎯 Devops1 Homepage Availability — SLO Dashboard

**SLO Reference:** `Devops1 Homepage Availability`  
**Monitor:** HTTP Check (`HTTP_CHECK-63169A43EEB83483`)

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| **SLO Target** | `$slo_target`% |
| **Evaluation Period** | `$eval_days` days |
| **Burn Thresholds** | Slow ≤`$slow_pct`% · Medium ≤`$medium_pct`% · Fast ≤`$fast_pct`% · Critical ≥`$critical_pct`% |

---

| Gate | Budget Consumed | Action |
|------|----------------|--------|
| 🟢 **1 = GO** | ≤50% | Deploy freely |
| 🟡 **2 = CAUTION** | 50–100% | Only critical changes |
| 🔴 **3 = FROZEN** | >100% EXHAUSTED | **STOP EVERYTHING** |

2.title: SLO Status (%)

3.title: Error Budget (% points above target)
3.query:
timeseries availability = avg(dt.synthetic.http.availability), from: now()-7d, filter:{ dt.entity.http_check == "HTTP_CHECK-63169A43EEB83483" }
| fieldsAdd avg_availability = arrayAvg(availability)
| fieldsAdd slo_target = toDouble($slo_target)
| fieldsAdd error_budget_pct = round(avg_availability - slo_target, decimals:3)
| fields error_budget_pct

9.title: Current Burn Category
9.query:
timeseries availability = avg(dt.synthetic.http.availability), from: now()-1d, filter:{ dt.entity.http_check == "HTTP_CHECK-63169A43EEB83483" }
| fieldsAdd avg_availability_1d = arrayAvg(availability)
| fieldsAdd slo_target = toDouble($slo_target)
| fieldsAdd slow_threshold = toDouble($slow_pct)
| fieldsAdd medium_threshold = toDouble($medium_pct)
| fieldsAdd critical_threshold = toDouble($critical_pct)
| fieldsAdd total_minutes = toDouble($eval_days) * 24.0 * 60.0
| fieldsAdd error_budget_total = (100.0 - slo_target) / 100.0 * total_minutes
| fieldsAdd minutes_in_1d = 24.0 * 60.0
| fieldsAdd downtime_1d = (100.0 - avg_availability_1d) / 100.0 * minutes_in_1d
| fieldsAdd projected_burn_pct = round(downtime_1d / error_budget_total * 100.0 * toDouble($eval_days), decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd burn_category = if(projected_burn_pct < slow_threshold, then:"🟢 Slow (healthy)", else:if(projected_burn_pct < medium_threshold, then:"🟡 Medium (caution)", else:if(projected_burn_pct < critical_threshold, then:"🟠 Fast (alert)", else:"🔴 Critical (emergency)")))
| fields burn_category

11.title: SLO Summary
11.query:
timeseries availability = avg(dt.synthetic.http.availability), from: now()-7d, filter:{ dt.entity.http_check == "HTTP_CHECK-63169A43EEB83483" }
| fieldsAdd avg_availability = arrayAvg(availability)
| fieldsAdd slo_target = toDouble($slo_target)
| fieldsAdd slo_status = round(avg_availability, decimals:3)
| fieldsAdd error_budget_pct = round(avg_availability - slo_target, decimals:3)
| fieldsAdd error_budget_remaining_pct = round((avg_availability - slo_target) / (100.0 - slo_target) * 100.0, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd total_minutes = toDouble($eval_days) * 24.0 * 60.0
| fieldsAdd allowed_downtime_minutes = round((100.0 - slo_target) / 100.0 * total_minutes, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd actual_downtime_minutes = round((100.0 - avg_availability) / 100.0 * total_minutes, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd budget_remaining_minutes = round(allowed_downtime_minutes - actual_downtime_minutes, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd budget_consumed_pct = round(actual_downtime_minutes / allowed_downtime_minutes * 100.0, decimals:2)
| fields slo_target, slo_status, error_budget_pct, error_budget_remaining_pct, allowed_downtime_minutes, actual_downtime_minutes, budget_remaining_minutes, budget_consumed_pct

12.title: Error Budget Burndown
12.query:
timeseries availability = avg(dt.synthetic.http.availability), from: now()-7d, filter:{ dt.entity.http_check == "HTTP_CHECK-63169A43EEB83483" }, interval: 1d
| fieldsAdd slo_target = toDouble($slo_target)
| fieldsAdd error_budget_pct = (100.0 - slo_target) * toDouble($eval_days)
| fieldsAdd downtime_pct = 100 - availability[]
| fieldsAdd cumulative_downtime_pct = arrayCumulativeSum(downtime_pct)
| fieldsAdd budget_remaining = error_budget_pct - cumulative_downtime_pct[]
| fields timeframe, interval, budget_remaining

13.title: Availability Trend with SLO Target
13.query:
timeseries availability = avg(dt.synthetic.http.availability), from: now()-7d, filter:{ dt.entity.http_check == "HTTP_CHECK-63169A43EEB83483" }, interval: 1d
| fieldsAdd rolling_avg = arrayMovingAvg(availability, 3)
| fields timeframe, interval, availability, rolling_avg

14.title: Daily Burn Rate (% of budget per day)
14.query:
timeseries availability = avg(dt.synthetic.http.availability), from: now()-7d, filter:{ dt.entity.http_check == "HTTP_CHECK-63169A43EEB83483" }, interval: 1d
| fieldsAdd slo_target = toDouble($slo_target)
| fieldsAdd error_budget_total_pct = (100.0 - slo_target) * toDouble($eval_days)
| fieldsAdd daily_downtime_pct = 100 - availability[]
| fieldsAdd daily_burn_rate = daily_downtime_pct[] / error_budget_total_pct * 100
| fields timeframe, interval, daily_burn_rate

15.content:
# 🚨 DEPLOYMENT FREEZE PROTOCOL

**When Deployment Gate = 3 (FROZEN):**

## ⛔ STOP ALL DEPLOYMENTS IMMEDIATELY

1. **No feature releases** — only stability patches
2. **No infrastructure changes** — freeze all configs
3. **Focus 100%** on root cause analysis
4. **Escalate** to engineering leadership
5. **Postmortem required** before resuming

---

### 📋 Operational Guidance

| Category | Action Required |
|----------|----------------|
| 🟢 **Slow** | No action. Safe to deploy. |
| 🟡 **Medium** | Monitor closely. Be thoughtful. |
| 🟠 **Fast** | Minimize risky changes. |
| 🔴 **Critical** | **STOP** all deployments. |

**Error Budget Formula:**  
Budget (min) = `(100 − SLO%) / 100 × eval_days × 24h × 60m`

16.title: Burn Category Thresholds Reference
16.query:
data record(slo_target = toDouble($slo_target), eval_days = toDouble($eval_days), slow_pct = toDouble($slow_pct), medium_pct = toDouble($medium_pct), fast_pct = toDouble($fast_pct), critical_pct = toDouble($critical_pct))
| fieldsAdd total_minutes = eval_days * 24.0 * 60.0
| fieldsAdd error_budget_minutes = round((100.0 - slo_target) / 100.0 * total_minutes, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd slow_minutes = round(error_budget_minutes * slow_pct / 100, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd medium_minutes = round(error_budget_minutes * medium_pct / 100, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd fast_minutes = round(error_budget_minutes * fast_pct / 100, decimals:2)
| fieldsAdd critical_minutes = round(error_budget_minutes * critical_pct / 100, decimals:2)
| fields error_budget_minutes, slow_minutes, medium_minutes, fast_minutes, critical_minutes
